description: This file contains an abstract class AbstractDevOpsCommand in Java that implements the DevOpsCommand interface. It provides base functionality for DevOps commands, including handling service name and instance, constructing payloads, and standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: AbstractDevOpsCommand
classes.description: An abstract class implementing DevOpsCommand, providing common properties and methods for DevOps commands, such as handling service name and instance, and building JSON payloads.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name if present.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance identifier if present.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the service name and instance to the JSON payload, considering the schema version and a predicate for filtering JSON fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on superclass, service name, and instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering service name, instance, and superclass equality.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality check; confirms the other object is an instance of AbstractDevOpsCommand.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including serviceName, instance, and superclass info.
